title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Since past 3 years searching for bride. Many proposals are coming but still it is unsuccessful. Please suggest any dua for getting married soon. 2709 views Q. Respected pious scholars, my eye is down since ages. I use spectacles. 1796 views Q. One of my friend was telling that one of the Aalim who if famous and solving many personal problems by quranic verses by giving TAWWEZ and other thing to overcome such problems , I am confused wheter to approach him because this may be a disbilief from allah. plz. advise is it allowed to sought such Aalims 1835 views Q. Is it possible for istikharah to change decisions over time for example if i prayed istikharah for a decision and it came out negative but then can i pray it again months later and then it comes out positive maybe because situations have change etc. The thing may not have been good at that time but now it is good for me? 4607 views Q. I have been married for more than two year. I have no child and as per Doctor the reason of infertility is unexplained. Please let me know the reason and guide me how can I overcome from it. 1976 views Q. I am a working lady.I am entering into 30s.I am still unmarried and waiting for a reasonable proposal.My parents particularly my father doesn?t take interest in arranging my marriage.They are not fear of my single marital status and increasing age.But I am much worried as in this society it is very difficult for a woman to live without a shelter and HUSBAND is a real shelter for a woman but my parents think as my job serves as a shelter and future protection for me. It is stongly requested to tell me some wazifa or zikar for a good proposal and change of mind of my father who is not interested in my marriage.Or suggest some ruhani elaj. 3092 views Q. All Amils said he is under influence. Can you please look into his case and advise me. 6182 views Q. Please send dua for its coontrol. Pl treat this urgent. 1775 views Q. 1642 views Q. There is a brother, who often tells me, that he is not Arbian, and hence he will not say Arabic Duas. Rather he would use the mother tongue in his duas. He does not use the words 'Assalamualaikum' but would often say 'salamoona' or 'hi-hello',. Should we as muslims learn the Arabic duas in Arabic or is that brother right in his viewpoint? By the way, he speaks in a very disrespecful, almost to the extent abuses, language against Muftis, and Ulema. I hope I would be replied and guided. 1455 views Q. As far as I understood Tauheed is (iyyaka na-aabudu wa iyyaka nastaeein) and there is no ayat in Quran and no hadith 2578 views Q. My name is Nusrath. I got married in 2004 but due to a lot of mental torture from my husband I happen to give Khula which he forced me becoze he said if he gives talaq then whatever things he has given me he cant take it back. The marriage lasted 2 and half months. I stayed at home for 6 months after Khula and later started working and from last 5 years I have been working just 1 and half mont back I resigned my job. My parents are looking for getting me married again but nothing positive is happening I have tried reading Taubah namaz then hajath namaz then after every namaz I read Ya lateefu before and after darood sharif then Surah Iqlas also. Kindly advise me so that I get settled in life again Inshallah as my parents are really worried for me. 1796 views Q. We have been through few problems in last few years.
